details.imageSource: Evans, 12 October 1954, UN New York, Photo UN7659387
details.summary: American librarian and third Director-General of the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO) 1953-1958
details.life: Was born 13 October 1902 in Sayerville, Texas, United States, and passed away 23 December 1981 in San Antonio, Texas. He was the son of George Washington Evans, railroad foreman, and Lillie Johnson. On 12 September 1925 he married Helen Murphy. They had one son.
details.editors: Bob Reinalda, Kent J. Kille and Jaci L. Eisenberg
